name: akb-mcp
description: Connect Codex to the local Agent Knowledge Base MCP read and manage endpoints.

interface.shortDescription: Search, compare, and confidence-review knowledge through local AKB.
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to Agent Knowledge Base for scoped knowledge search, source reading, candidate comparison, validation, submission, and confidence-gated Agent review.
defaultPrompt: Search Agent Knowledge Base for relevant project knowledge.
Read an Agent Knowledge Base resource and summarize its evidence.
Compare and review a knowledge submission with the Agent confidence gate.
Validate and submit a knowledge draft when supplementary evidence is needed.
